messages:
maria_gupta: quick follow-up on mid-stream fallback: propose a lightweight switchback handshake so edge can hand off tail without re-emitting tokens.

alex_cheng: curious—how is switchback different from epoch/commit? need to avoid extra RTT and keep batching stable.

sam_lee: switchback = one-off handshake: edge requests Switchback-Window with a lastConfirmedOffset, upstream returns Switchback-ACK with a token. edge then routes future fragments to fallback. no re-batching of already-dispatched fragments.

jin_ops: implementation note: keep Switchback-ACK TTL short and make ACK idempotent. maintain local cache of tokens to avoid repeated RPCs under flakey networks.

maria_gupta: headers sketch: 

``
X-Redwood-Switchback-Request: 1
X-Redwood-Last-Confirmed-Offset: 2048
X-Redwood-Switchback-Ack: sb-1-00a7
X-Redwood-Fallback-Mode: short-context|cache-prefix|quantized
Hedging-Safe: true|false
```

alex_cheng: billing: include X-Redwood-Billing-Cut: <ack-token> to mark checkpoint. only bill tokens after checkpoint for whichever backend finishes the stream.

sam_lee: safety: only permit automatic hedges if Hedging-Safe=true. otherwise fallback must be single-path or read-only. add Idempotency-Envelope for side-effecting requests.

jin_ops: backpressure: if upstream cannot ACK in threshold, edge should emit progress-hint trailer and choose degrade-mode; avoid blocking client-visible stream.

maria_gupta: action items: 1) spec headers & state diagram, 2) implement idempotent ack cache at edge, 3) checkpointed billing hook, 4) add integration test for switchback (no double-emit).

deploy-bot: build artifact uploaded: switchback-proto v0.1 (ci/4990012370)
